component.name: Safe Exam Browser for Linux
component.summary: Unofficial SEB-compatible exam browser for Linux

description.p: An independent, Safe Exam Browser compatible exam browser for Linux (Ubuntu, Zorin OS, CachyOS and derivatives). It reads .seb configuration files, computes the SEB Config Key, and sends the SEB integrity headers so that exam platforms such as Moodle recognise the session.
This is not an official product of the Safe Exam Browser project or ETH Zurich.

ul.li: Reads .seb files (XML plist, gzip, password-encrypted) and seb:// links
Kiosk mode: fullscreen, always-on-top, no popups, no external programs
Keyboard lockdown for the shortcuts a configuration disables
URL filtering with SEB expressions and regular expressions
Emergency exit (Ctrl+Shift+Q) so a user is never trapped
Background updates that install on quit, never during an exam

description.p: Exact Windows user agent, encrypted-configuration support, and the taskbar removed.
